scripts.setup: uv python install 3.12 --directory prodia_v02_backend && cd prodia_v02_backend && uv sync --extra dev && cd .. && pnpm install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names back,front --prefix-colors blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm run dev:back" "pnpm run dev:front"
scripts.dev:back: cd prodia_v02_backend && uv run uvicorn src.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 6034
scripts.lint: concurrently --names back,front --prefix-colors blue,green "pnpm run lint:back" "pnpm run lint:front"
scripts.lint:back: cd prodia_v02_backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run black --check .
scripts.typecheck: concurrently --names back,front --prefix-colors blue,green "pnpm run typecheck:back" "pnpm run typecheck:front"
scripts.typecheck:back: cd prodia_v02_backend && uv run mypy src
scripts.test: concurrently --names back,front --prefix-colors blue,green "pnpm run test:back" "pnpm run test:front"
scripts.gen:types: cd prodia_v02_backend && uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py && cd ../prodia_v02_frontend && pnpm exec openapi-typescript ../prodia_v02_backend/openapi.json -o src/shared/types/api.d.ts
